label: MALAT1::TFEB

sections.text: MALAT1 produces a long noncoding RNA involved in nuclear RNA organization and gene regulation.
TFEB encodes a MiT/TFE-family transcription factor that regulates lysosome biogenesis and autophagy.

The rearrangement places TFEB under MALAT1 promoter control, increasing TFEB expression and lysosomal/metabolic transcription. The MALAT1 partner is noncoding; the defining mechanism is promoter substitution, not a new MALAT1-derived kinase or peptide domain.
